job_type.description: An arbitrary designator for the job type or kind, typically supplied by the job requestor.

description.description: An arbitrary free-form description of the job, as supplied by the job requestor.

status.description: The current state of the job, to the effect of its success, failure, etc.

requested_at.description: The time (rfc3339 timestamp) at which this job was requested or submitted.

href.description: The URI of the user who requested this job.

terminated_at.description: The time (rfc3339 timestamp) at which this job terminated, either successfully or failingly.

result.description: The result produced by the job, typically a URI (with 'href' sub-property), or an error in case of failure.

href.description: The href to collect the response body
